campaignUrls.title: Campaign URLs or IDs
campaignUrls.description: Optional Content Rewards campaign links or UUIDs. When set, only these campaigns are analysed.

keyword.title: Keyword
keyword.description: If no campaign URLs are given, keep Discover campaigns whose title, brand, handle, category or description contains this text, then take the top N.

boards.title: Discover boards
boards.description: Public Content Rewards Discover pages used to find campaigns when no URLs are given.

maxCampaigns.title: Max campaigns
maxCampaigns.description: How many campaigns to analyse (and whose public top clips will be billed).

maxClipsPerCampaign.title: Max clips per campaign
maxClipsPerCampaign.description: Content Rewards usually lists up to 10 public top clips. Cap is applied after that.

clipPlatforms.title: Clip platforms
clipPlatforms.description: Keep only public top clips on these platforms.

minViews.title: Minimum views per clip
minViews.description: Drop public top clips below this view count.

platforms.title: Campaign platforms
platforms.description: When discovering campaigns, keep those that allow at least one of these platforms.

category.title: Category contains
category.description: Optional campaign category filter (e.g. Music, Sports, Entertainment).

minRatePer1k.title: Minimum $ per 1,000 views
minRatePer1k.description: When discovering campaigns, drop those below this CPM.

minBudgetLeft.title: Minimum budget left (USD)
minBudgetLeft.description: When discovering campaigns, drop those with less remaining budget than this.

openOnly.title: Open campaigns only
openOnly.description: When discovering campaigns, hide those that require an application.

status.title: Status
status.description: Optional campaign status filter, e.g. active.

enrichYouTube.title: Enrich YouTube clips
enrichYouTube.description: Look up public duration and publish date for YouTube clips (datacenter proxy on platform runs). Failed lookups are not charged as extra events; the campaign-page clip is still returned.

enrichTikTok.title: Enrich TikTok clips
enrichTikTok.description: Look up public duration and publish date from TikTok video pages when they are visible without a login. Instagram, X and Facebook are never fetched.

maxConcurrency.title: Max concurrency
maxConcurrency.description: How many YouTube/TikTok lookups to run in parallel (1-10).

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Used only for YouTube (and TikTok) enrichment. Leave the default Apify datacenter proxy on for platform runs. Do not enable residential groups.
